device_label: 1 mm SOH IQ modulator (two nested MZMs), SOXD123, GSG CPW
cladding: SOXD123 organic electro-optic material (SilOriX GmbH), poled
epitaxy_or_stack: Two Si rails forming a slot filled with organic EO material; Fig. 1(b) labels 220 nm (rail height), 160 nm (slot) and 90 nm (slab); graded n-type doping (nD, nD+, nD++) from rails to ohmic contacts; Al electrodes connected through vias and thin Si slabs
modulation_format: 16QAM 200 GBd over 85 km SMF (NGMI 0.857, above SD-FEC 25% OH threshold; AIR 712 Gbit/s at 192 GBd); 64QAM 144 GBd over 85 km SMF (NGMI above SD-FEC threshold; AIR 743 Gbit/s); single polarization, RRC roll-off 0.05
driver: Keysight M8199B AWG drives the IQM directly with no RF amplifier, 20 cm RF cables, double GSG probe, 50 ohm coaxial terminations; Tx-DSP predistortion of AWG and cables, not of the modulator
notes: Vpi 780 mV and 790 mV for the two nested MZMs (larger entered; frequency, wavelength and arm convention not stated). Drive swing below 1.1 Vpp. Fiber-to-fiber figure written as transmission 17.7 dB at 1550 nm. ECL 17.8 dBm is laser power, not on-chip. CSNR 17.2 dB (144 GBd) to 11.5 dB (200 GBd), 0.7 dB penalty vs B2B. Net rate and line rate not stated. Foundry not named (industry-standard silicon photonic foundry process). Coupler type (GC or EC) for the 17.7 dB not stated.

device_label: 40 um Ge length ultra-thin Ge EAM (device 1), 300 mm Si photonics
il_onchip_includes: Ge-EAM including Si to Ge/Si interface transitions and absorber; exact definition not stated
il_onchip_excludes: not stated (grating-coupler and fiber handling not described)
epitaxy_or_stack: p-i-n junction on recessed Si with Ge on Si (P++/P+ and N+/N++ Si regions, Cu vias, Fig. 1(a)); Ge top flush with the 220 nm Si waveguide (height difference h = 0) by CMP thinning
modulation_format: NRZ 120 Gbit/s eyes at 1590 to 1610 nm (dynamic SNR 5.44 to 5.70); PAM-4 150 GBd eye, TDECQ 4.46 dB, no offline DSP; all at -1.8 V bias
notes: Bandwidth: 3 dB EO bandwidth stated to exceed 110 GHz for 1 to 4 V reverse bias at -1 dBm input power; S21 down 1 dB at 110 GHz at 4 V; trace is noisy above 80 GHz; 1 V trace has a single-point spike to about -3.2 dB near 104 GHz, 2 to 4 V traces stay above -3 dB (Fig. 3(a)). Extrapolated 180 GHz is from an RC-model fit (Rs 60 ohm, Cj 7 fF, Cp 8 fF, L 30 pH) and is not entered. IL 1.5 dB at 1600 nm; IL below 2.3 dB over 1590 to 1610 nm; bias for IL not stated. Static ER max 3 dB at 7 V. Dynamic bias -1.8 V (eyes), EO response at 1 to 4 V. Fab not named.

device_label: 100 um Ge length ultra-thin Ge EAM (device 2), static only
il_onchip_includes: Ge-EAM including Si to Ge/Si interface transitions and absorber; exact definition not stated
il_onchip_excludes: not stated (grating-coupler and fiber handling not described)
notes: Static spectra only, 1590 to 1610 nm, bias 1 to 7 V. IL remains below 6.3 dB across that window (Fig. 2(b)); maximum ER 7.5 dB. No dynamic measurement. Fab not named.

device_label: GeSi EAM (imec ISIPP50G), 1563 nm, 160 GBd PAM4
il_onchip_excludes: grating couplers (4.5 dB each) and the 4 dB self-heating loss under operation
modulation_format: PAM4 160 GBd, BU-GRU equalizer, 35 taps: BER 4.22e-3 back-to-back (RoP 5 dBm) and 4.36e-3 after 100 m SMF, below the 6.25% OH HD-FEC threshold 4.5e-3
driver: Keysight M8199B AWG (256 GSa/s) with electrical amplifier (EA, Fig. 1(a)), 110 GHz bias tee at -1.4 V, 1 mm GS probe; 100 GHz PIN photodiode, 110 GHz real-time oscilloscope
notes: EO response at 1.4 V reverse bias to about 67 GHz (Fig. 1(b)). Authors state above 67 GHz (abstract, p.2); Fig. 1(b) EAM trace has a notch to about -3.2 dB near 46.6 GHz (below -2 dB from about 45 to 48 GHz) and ends near -2 dB at 67 GHz. Static ER 3.1 dB at -2 V (text), bias tee -1.4 V in the link. EAM length and geometry not given. RoP 4.8 dBm for 100 m in Fig. 3(c) vs 5 dBm in text. Net 300 Gb/s at 160 GBd (6.25% OH HD-FEC). Laser 9.6 dBm, +13 dBm after EDFA (not on-chip power).

device_label: 0.5 mm Si-FenGlass slot MZM, GSGSG, push-pull
cladding: FenGlass (Polaris ferroelectric nematic glass) dispensed as ink and processed to the ferroelectric glass phase; monodomain set by a small DC field; no encapsulation
epitaxy_or_stack: 220 nm silicon photonics platform; doped Si slot waveguides in both MZI arms (TE0, C-band) filled with FenGlass; GSGSG traveling-wave electrode; 50 ohm on-chip termination; edge coupling and strip-to-slot converters
modulation_format: 100 m SSMF, 41-tap FFE + 1-tap DFE: PAM4 176 GBd net 330 Gb/s (HD-FEC 6.7% OH); PAM6 136 GBd net 330 Gb/s (HD-FEC); PAM4 224 GBd net 358 Gb/s (SD-FEC 25% OH); PAM6 200 GBd net 414 Gb/s (SD-FEC); PAM8 168 GBd net 403 Gb/s (SD-FEC)
driver: Keysight M8199B AWG (256 GSa/s), differential channel 2.4 Vpp, 67 GHz GSGSG probe, pre-emphasis; no RF amplifier stated; 110 GHz photodiode, no TIA
notes: Vpi 6.7 V from a 1 MHz sinusoid. Paper gives VpiL 3.4 V mm (phase extraction; device not stated, equals 6.7 V x 0.5 mm within rounding) and in-device r33 27 pm/V. Fig. 2(a) linear to 20 Vpp (about 0.5 MV/cm). HTOL over 1000 h at 70 C, 4 Vpp, about 10 dBm, unencapsulated. Combined Tx/probe/PD response only (Fig. 1(b)); EO bandwidth not reported. Foundry not named. ITLA 15 dBm at 1550 nm tuned to quadrature. Fig. 2(a) slope (about 3.8 V per pi at 1 MHz, approximate reading) matches neither device; VpiL not assigned.

device_label: 1 mm Si-FenGlass slot MZM, Vpi versus low frequency
notes: Vpi vs frequency from 50 mHz to 1 MHz with a DC-coupled sinusoid (Fig. 2(b)): about 2.84 to 3.21 V, changes about 10% over 7 decades. 1 MHz value (3.2 V) read from the plot; entered as quasi-static. Drive, wavelength and electrode not stated for this device.

device_label: 3 mm BTO DP-IQM package with wire-bonded differential drivers
substrate: thermal-oxide wafer (BTO transferred from a silicon growth substrate)
epitaxy_or_stack: Epitaxial BTO thin film transferred from a silicon growth substrate onto a thermal-oxide wafer; high-speed and DC phase shifters defined in BTO; silicon nitride edge couplers; on-chip 50 ohm terminations; free-space polarization rotating and combining optics in the package
modulation_format: Net 1 Tb/s per lambda: 125 GBd DP-32QAM and 105 GBd DP-64QAM below SD25 FEC, over 80 km (ZR-modeled) and 2 km (bi-directional self-homodyne coherent-lite); 120 GBd DP-16QAM BER 6e-3 (ZR) and 6.3e-3 (2 km), below OFEC 2e-2; 5 km DP-16QAM recoverable below OFEC; no degradation at 85 C
driver: Differential RF drivers, 23 dB gain, wire-bonded to GSSG RF interface; Keysight M8199A AWG 128 GSa/s, four differential channels, Tx pre-emphasis
notes: Package-level numbers: 1 GHz Vpi 0.4 V includes RF driver, BTO die and test structures (not a device Vpi, not entered); 6 dB EO S21 about 25 GHz at 30 and 85 C includes drivers and wire bonds (Fig. 1(b)). Fiber-to-fiber IL 14.5 dB per polarization. The 3 mm refers to the DP-IQM die; phase-shifter length not stated. DC phase shifters total under 5 mW. Wavelength not stated (C-band ITLA, 15 dBm, 100 kHz). Fig. 1(b): 30 C trace first touches -6 dB near 18.5-19.5 GHz, below from about 24 GHz; S21 reference not stated.
